children: Mutsamudu, Comoros, September 22nd, 2026, Chainwire
MEXC, a pioneer in 0-fee digital asset trading, has launched its
“Real Stocks, Real Friends”

, allowing users to bring their friends to Wall Street through RealStocks and earn rewards. Building on MEXC’s previous “Trade Wall Street, Without Walls, the event reflects MEXC’s efforts to lower barriers to the U.S. stock market for crypto-native users.
MEXC previously launched the
“Trade Wall Street, Without Walls”
campaign to help users break through five traditional barriers to stock market participation. These include the
Access Wall, Fee Wall, Time Wall, Capital Wall and Direction Wall

, in which MEXC addresses through its products, trading infrastructure and market access. MEXC’s efforts extend beyond lowering these barriers. Its recent initiatives also help users better understand markets, identify their trading preferences and explore more ways to participate.
Opportunity Compass
provides structured education across global markets, asset classes, market trends, emerging opportunities and risk, while
“Discover Your Wall Street DNA”

helps users identify their trading styles and explore stock products aligned with their preferences. The “Real Stocks, Real Friends” further extends this approach through an invitation-based model, allowing existing users to invite friends to discover RealStocks and explore the U.S. stock market. Inviters can earn rewards, while qualified invited users can receive additional benefits by completing the required activities.
The “
Real Stocks, Real Friends
” Event runs from
September 10 to October 15, 2026 (UTC)

. During the event, users can invite friends to open a RealStocks account and complete the required tasks. When an invited friend completes the required RealStocks tasks, including a net purchase of at least 100 USDT and a three-day holding period, the inviter can receive a reward. Qualified invited users can also unlock a Futures Bonus for both the inviter and the invited user after completing the required futures task.

RealStocks is an innovative cross-market trading product launched by MEXC in collaboration with regulated brokerage partners, providing crypto-native users with access to real U.S. stocks and ETFs. The product supports more than 7,000 U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs, allowing users to purchase and hold real shares, with applicable shareholder benefits including dividend eligibility.

As a one-stop trading platform, MEXC also provides multiple ways to participate in the stock market across different stages. Its Stock Ecosystem spans Pre-IPO, IPO and Post-IPO opportunities, including Pre-IPO Futures, Pre-IPO Launchpad, IPO Launchpad, IPO Express, RealStocks, Tokenized Stocks and Stock Futures. Selected products also offer features such as 0-fee trading, extended or around-the-clock market access, and the ability to take both long and short positions. These options create more ways for users to participate in the stock market.
For more details and to participate in the “Real Stocks, Real Friends”, visit the MEXC official event page.
About MEXC

Founded in 2018, MEXC is a leading global multi-asset trading platform built as your 0-fee gateway to infinite opportunities. Serving users across 170+ markets, MEXC provides simple and efficient access to crypto, stocks, tokenized assets, derivatives, and a growing range of TradFi-linked opportunities through one account and one gateway.

With 0 trading fees, deep liquidity, broad asset coverage, and a high-performance trading experience, MEXC is designed for retail users who want to discover earlier, act faster, and trade with fewer barriers. As crypto and traditional finance continue to converge, MEXC is committed to making global opportunities more accessible, helping users trade freely and MEXCmize every opportunity.
